newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe industrial index firmer on shares' gains.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe industrial index firmer on shares' gains.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index closed 44.11 points firmer at 10,338.52 on Thursday, buoyed by firmer deals in a number of counters, brokers said.
"The industrials continued active today with big volumes seen. There was heavy trading in Interfresh with over 10.5 million shares going through as a special bargain," one broker said.
Brokers expect more activity on the market with the closing on Friday of national dairy Dairibord's issue which they say should free up more cash for investment in the bourse.

Counters to trade firmer on Thursday included clothing retailers Edgars which put on 20 cents to 800 while pharmaceutical firm Caps and sugar growers Hippo were 50 cents firmer at 2,700 and 1,650 respectively.
Others to gain were seed company Seedco and timber producer Border, both up 10 cents to 360 and 1,460 respectively while hoteliers Zimsun climbed up 15 cents to 420.
Minings were on the quiet side with counters trading at previous levels, leaving the seven share index there unchanged at 929.61.
